title: "Confidence Interval for Population Proportion"
format: html

## Question 1 (3 points)

In a recent epidemiological study, researchers investigated the prevalence of a particular viral infection in a small town. Out of a random sample of $n = 400$ residents, 68 tested positive for the virus.

In the code block below, construct a 95% confidence interval for the proportion of residents in the town who are infected with the virus. THEN INTERPRET THE INTERVAL IN CONTEXT.

```{r, echo = TRUE}
n <- 400
phat <- 68/n
alpha <- 0.05
z_quant <- qnorm(1-alpha/2)

phat + c(-1, 1)*z_quant*sqrt(phat*(1-phat)/n)
```

[We are 95% confident that the true proportion of residents infected with the virus is between 13.32% and 20.68%.]{style="color: red;"}
